why: the run stamped itself UNDERPOWERED against a PRE-HOC MDE whose standard error was 1.61x too large; the realised standard error resolves the effect it measured, so the stamp was wrong in the conservative direction and is corrected here rather than by editing the receipt

the_power_correction.why_the_prehoc_estimate_was_wrong: power_check derives the long-short's monthly sd from the median cross-sectional sd divided by sqrt(names per leg), which treats names inside a month as independent draws. The confidence-weighted book this job actually trades has lower dispersion than that proxy implies.
the_power_correction.reading: a power check is a DESIGN quantity computed before the data; once an effect is measured, its own standard error is the honest one. Both belong in the receipt, and the code now prints both.

why_this_is_CONDITIONAL_and_not_a_claim: NO TRANSACTION COSTS anywhere in this grading. The arm's +21.845%/yr and the control's +5.656%/yr are GROSS. A monthly-rebalanced long-short over ~60 names would pay roughly 6%/yr at 25 bps a side on full turnover.

The PRIMARY number is a DIFFERENCE between two books that rebalance identically on the same dates, so costs very largely cancel in it -- the +16.189%/yr is approximately cost-robust even though the levels are not. That is an argument, not a measurement: turnover is not tracked by this job and should be.
The panel is 135 names and mega-cap skewed (NVDA, SPY, AMD dominate the document counts); this is not a cross-section.
One prompt, one digest construction, one model, one horizon. No multiplicity control, and the prompt was not pre-registered.
The shuffled-digest control itself earns +5.656%/yr at t 1.79, so the machinery is not inert; only the difference is interpretable.
The AMNESIA canary passes (-0.0041, masked marginally BETTER than real names), so the model is reading rather than recalling -- but the canary is 300 cells, not the whole read.
corrected_reading: Over 2015-2024, a local 7B model reading only that month's ANONYMISED news digest calls the next month's market-adjusted direction better than the identical pipeline reading a digest from a random other month: +16.189%/yr, t 3.922 on 112 monthly date blocks, sign accuracy 0.542 against the control's 0.4911. The effect is above the MDE recomputed from its own standard error (11.56%/yr). It is CONDITIONAL, not a claim: gross of costs at the level, on a 135-name panel, from one unregistered prompt.
next_step: pre-register the prompt, the digest construction and the book BEFORE widening; add turnover and a cost line; and widen the panel, which is the binding constraint at 135 names -- not the model.
